name: kjs-srs-01-mission-control
description: KJS-SRS-01 — SomaiyaSat & SomaiyaPod mission control dashboard (simulation only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta -k "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta -k "npm -w backend run start" "npm -w frontend run start"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
